_meta.description: Dated ground photos, by the owner or by people who gave permission to use them. Entries with kind "drone" are stills from InfraUnfiltered's drone flights, shared with permission (owner, 2026-10-16; these videos shared by the owner on 2026-11-11): Phase 1 from the flight of 20 Oct 2026 (8cCOx0tovUM, also in aerial.json), Phase 2 from the flight of 24 Oct 2026 (jqqYy_kCPQE). Each still is matched to its station by the creator's on-screen station label; 'date' is the day the video was published, video_t is the second in the video, and source_url opens the video there. 'pairs' are before/after pairs shown under the satellite comparison. 'stations' holds photos for each station page, keyed by the station id in stations.json. Put the image files in public/photos/ (location data removed) and add entries below. See UPDATING.md. Ground photos by Pratham Kushwaha (@prathmkushwaha) are used with his permission (X reply to the owner, 5 Nov 2026: https://x.com/prathmkushwaha/status/2118058612522356948); their 'date' is the day of his post.

kapurbawdi.alt: High view over Kapurbawdi junction: two metro viaducts curve over Ghodbunder Road between residential towers, with the hills of Yeoor behind
kapurbawdi.caption: The Line 4 and Line 5 viaducts over Kapurbawdi junction, from a tower nearby

kapurbawdi.alt: Drone view of Kapurbawdi station with its green roof, the two tracks and their crossovers running out of it, and the road under the viaduct
kapurbawdi.caption: The station and the crossover tracks next to it

gaimukh.alt: Drone view down on Gaimukh station: two metro trains stand side by side on the tracks under the green station roofs, with the road on both sides
gaimukh.caption: Two trains parked at Gaimukh, the end of Phase 1

gowniwada.alt: Drone view along the viaduct into Gowniwada station, with its curved green roof, overhead wire masts and a footbridge on the left
gowniwada.caption: Track and overhead wires laid through the station

kasarvadavali.alt: Drone view along the tracks into Kasarvadavali station, under the steel frame of the roof, with green covers over the stairs on both sides
kasarvadavali.caption: Through the station under its roof frame

vijay-garden.alt: Drone view along the viaduct towards Vijay Garden station and its green roof, between a road and tall buildings
vijay-garden.caption: The viaduct running into the station

dongripada.alt: Drone view of Dongari Pada station and its green roof beside the road, with thick trees on the right; the creator's label names the station
dongripada.caption: The station beside the road, with trees on the hillside next to it

tikujiniwadi.alt: Drone view along the curving viaduct beside the road towards Tikuji-Ni-Wadi station, with cleared land on the right; the creator's label names the station
tikujiniwadi.caption: The viaduct curving towards the station

manpada.alt: Drone view inside Manpada station under the roof: the two tracks run between the platforms, with roof sheets, cables and materials piled on the platform edge
manpada.caption: Finishing work on the platforms, with materials still piled up

majiwada.alt: Drone view of Majiwada station and its green roof beside a building under construction, with the flyover and traffic on the left
majiwada.caption: The station next to the Majiwada flyover

cadbury-junction.alt: Drone view of Cadbury Junction station and its green roof, with two metro trains standing at the platforms and traffic on the road beside
cadbury-junction.caption: Two trains parked at Cadbury Junction, where Phase 1 ends

mahapalika-marg.alt: Drone view along the tracks into Mahapalika Marg station under its roof, with the road and traffic on the left
mahapalika-marg.caption: Track laid through the station. The creator says the roofing is done and electrical work, floor tiles and platform screen doors come next

rto-thane.alt: Drone view along the viaduct beside a tree-lined road to RTO Thane station, which has its steel roof frame but no roof sheets
rto-thane.caption: The station's roof frame, without its sheets. The creator says the roofing has not started

teen-haath-naka.alt: Drone view of Thane Teen Haath Naka station from the side: the long station with its steel roof frame and green signs, above the road, with housing towers behind; the creator's label names the station
teen-haath-naka.caption: The station from the side. The creator says a train came here for clearance tests

mulund-naka.alt: Drone view straight down on the steel roof frame over the tracks at Mulund Naka station, with a building's roof on the right
mulund-naka.caption: Looking down on the roof frame over the tracks. The creator says the roofing is moving towards its final stage

mulund-fire-station.alt: Drone view along the viaduct past a garden and thick trees to the Mulund Fire Station stop in the distance; the creator's label names the station
mulund-fire-station.caption: The viaduct running to the station. The creator says the roof poles are nearly done and the roofing has not started

sonapur.alt: Drone view along the viaduct at Sonapur, between a building under construction and a glass tower, with the station deck and its green-edged walls in the middle
sonapur.caption: The station deck between new towers. The creator says the roofing has not moved in three months

shangrila.alt: Two new pier caps on tall piers wrapped in scaffolding and green netting, seen from under the viaduct
shangrila.caption: Two new pier caps on the last piers before the station

shangrila.alt: Two pier caps under green covers on scaffolded piers, below power lines, with a crane in front
shangrila.caption: The same pier caps, from the road. One platform-level pier cap was left to place

shangrila.alt: Drone view along the viaduct over low buildings and trees towards Shangrila station; the creator's label names the station
shangrila.caption: The viaduct towards the station. The creator says platform slabs and U-girders are still going in here

bhandup.alt: Looking up from the road at Bhandup station: the viaduct overhead and the station block, partly under green netting, with a single tall pole standing on top
bhandup.caption: The first roof pole, on the Gaimukh side of the station

bhandup.alt: A large crane with a lime-green boom working beside the station at night, under street lights, with the viaduct and green netting on the left
bhandup.caption: A crane at the station at night, the day roof work began

bhandup.alt: The viaduct and the station seen from the other side of the road at dusk, under a tree, with shops and a hoarding below
bhandup.caption: The station from the other side

bhandup.alt: Looking along the station deck from the road: girders and concourse beams on the piers, with traffic and a foot bridge below
bhandup.caption: All the station girders in place

bhandup.alt: Close view of the station girders and cross arms, with steel bars sticking out of the concrete, over a busy shop-lined road
bhandup.caption: Girders and cross arms, with bars left out for the next pour

bhandup.alt: The viaduct curving into the station under green safety netting, with hoardings and street lights below
bhandup.caption: The station under green netting; parapet work had begun on the other side

bhandup.alt: Drone view of the viaduct curving between a tall red and white tower and low housing towards Bhandup Metro station
bhandup.caption: The viaduct curving towards the station. The creator says the station has not changed much in three months

bhandup-mahapalika.alt: Drone view along the tracks into Bhandup Mahapalika station, with a building under green netting on the left; the creator's label names the station
bhandup-mahapalika.caption: Track laid through the station deck. The creator says the roof poles have not started

naval-housing.alt: Drone view along the viaduct to Naval Housing station, with its green-edged deck, beside a playground and thick trees; the creator's label names the station
naval-housing.caption: The station deck among the trees. The creator says track laying goes on here and the roof poles have not started

gandhi-nagar.alt: A red crane lifting a girder into the concourse level of the station at night, beside a tall glass building
gandhi-nagar.caption: A concourse-level girder going up at night

gandhi-nagar.alt: Drone view of the viaduct curving into Gandhi Nagar station, with the Line 6 viaduct crossing in the back; the creator's labels name the station and Line 6
gandhi-nagar.caption: The viaduct into the station, with Line 6 crossing behind. The creator says the deck slab is done and the roof poles have not started
